changes.evidence: The 8 has a lower loop and upper crossing. A long descending stroke and final angular 4 survive, but the thick horizontal band hides the separator and parts of the possible 7. The crop does not justify removing the C alternatives.

The first group retains an upper fragment, an oval and a small detached right stroke; the next group is a low joined wave. These support a cautious reading but do not decide the possessive or its ending.
The word has a broken tall f with lower return, then a, a low u, one rising t and a terminal e. No interior l or long series of ascenders supports faculté or famille.
Initial a and the run of rounded strokes are visible, but several central and final joins have dropped out. The plausible reading remains explicitly uncertain.
At the right end of line 3 a small a has a separate grave stroke. The next line begins la with a looped l, then place with a p descender, tall l and separate low c/e.

The horizontal hyphen is certain. A separate short high stroke stands immediately above its right end, distinct from the circumflex over ê. Its status as an apostrophe or incidental mark is not decided.
The half shows the long f, rounded ou joins, low r, b ascender, dotted i and final s.
Capital S, the separate dot of i, low n and final h ascender/return can be followed in the half.

notes: This is a fully handwritten opening letter page addressed to Deligne, with a separate sideways forwarding note addressed to Breen in a smaller second hand. The apparent signature is retained with doubt. There is no visible author page number; 61 is archive pencil foliation and is represented only by a comment.
The heading begins Lodève le 27.; the rest of the date remains uncertain under the thick crossing band. H's note citing another exemplar is editorial metadata, not evidence used in this reading.

The writer discusses possibly replacing a first-cycle course in the first trimester with an algebra seminar on Mme Sinh's fourbis, possibly transferred to the context of double-quoted champs. The first cause phrase remains uncertain, but the next-line noun reads faute.

The author explicitly says the construction reste heuristique and then writes il doit y avoir un triangle distingué canonique. These are the author's claim and qualification, not a verification by this reader.

The inline complex definition and displayed invariants precede the triangle. The repeated i on Ext and in the bounds was noticed, but it was not used to force the differently shaped second H exponent. The triangle has E to E', E' to the apex, and apex to E, without additional arrow labels or decorations.

There is a visible overwrite in the first invariant row. Ext is live; the underlying name is tentatively Hom and remains inside deleted/unsure macros. No author insertion, separate author underline in the prose, drawing, stamp, or main-letter closing is visible on this page.

The copied left and bottom rules, isolated registration-like strokes and attachment/edge marks are not treated as author text or mathematical drawings. No deletion is inferred merely from the thick band across the date.

All thirteen tight crops were restricted to places left unresolved after the one-time half views; the sideways note was divided into distinct unresolved segments and rotated -90 degrees. No decided locus was re-cropped. No OCR, web, other-page image/text, or other reader output was used.
No mathematical proof or targeted validity check was performed. The checks array is therefore empty; ordinary symbol-by-symbol transcription has not been presented as mathematical verification.

coverage: Read the whole scan once (1687 × 2361), then each supplied full-resolution half once in order. Every heading/salutation word, all thirteen main prose lines, both invariant rows, the two-line triangle introduction, every triangle object, delimiter, index, prime and arrow, the entire sideways forwarding note and signature, the overwritten name and archive 61 were inspected. All C doubts were either resolved from the halves or one of the thirteen logged tight crops, or explicitly retained in reading.tex and doubts. H's omitted à la place and tentative opening words are supplied, its extra si and closing comma are excluded, its omitted underlying deleted name is represented, and its formula/label placement is aligned to the scan. The report records all observed disagreements and doubt resolutions. The physically blank remainder and copied artefacts were checked for additional writing. Only syntax/content consistency validation is performed; no LaTeX compilation.
